_frame: All coordinates are METRES in the figure's own axes (raw .sog XZ). NOTE the figure's x axis is NEGATED against viewer world x, so 'left' on the plot is 'right' in the room.
_islandNames: Optional, rank -> label. Affects the figure only.
_islandPads: Rank -> standoff in metres. Overrides --pad-tall / --pad-low for that island.
_include: Forces floor IN where a pad was too greedy. Intersected with the room's free space first, so it relaxes the standoff but stops at real geometry. Must TOUCH the main region or it is dropped.
_exclude: Carves floor OUT. Same three shape kinds.

include.note: Widen the north-east arm. The sliver between the north wall and the top of the desk was too short to move around in.

The east corridor, and the arc around the chair nub. The 0.32 m desk pad stood the boundary off far enough to pinch the corridor shut beside the chair; this brings it up to the chair surface. It reaches west to 0.25 to swallow the un-walkable slot that sat between this pad and the dub station pad — that slot forced the ring to run into it and back out, and RDP shaved its two walls past each other. Clipped to free space, so the chair stays solid.
The channel south of the dub station. Closes the loop, so the dub station can be walked all the way around. Thin — see the falloffZone covering it in demos.ts.
